local function sledge_vr_active(locomotion)
    if locomotion.index ~= GetLocalPlayer() or not locomotion.animState.alive then return false end
    local version, ready, x, y, z = GetPlayerHealth(-717, 9)
    local position=nil
    if type(x)=="number" and type(y)=="number" and type(z)=="number"
       and x==x and y==y and z==z and math.abs(x)<1e6 and math.abs(y)<1e6 and math.abs(z)<1e6 then
        position=Vec(x,y,z)
    end
    return version == 720 and ready == 1, position
end

local function sledge_vr_hands(locomotion, at)
    local rt, lt = GetToolHandPoseWorldTransform(locomotion.index)
    if not rt and not lt then return false end
    local animator, state = locomotion.animator, locomotion.animState
    local function place(target, side)
        if not target then return end
        local adjust = GetAnimatorAdjustTransformIK(animator, "ik_hand_"..side)
        if adjust then target = TransformToParentTransform(target, adjust) end
        -- Reachable grips stay attached instead of retaining solver error while
        -- moving. Beyond reach retain the connected constrained arm solution.
        local shoulder=GetBoneWorldTransform(animator,"shoulder_"..side)
        local reach=GetBoneChainLength(animator,"shoulder_"..side,"hand_"..side)
        local lock=shoulder and reach and reach>0 and
                   VecLength(VecSub(target.pos,shoulder.pos))<=reach*.98
        SetAnimatorTransformIK(animator, "shoulder_"..side, "hand_"..side, target, 1.0, 0.0, lock==true, true)
    end
    if rt then state.rightHandWeight=1;state.lastRightHandIK=TransformToLocalTransform(at,rt) end
    if lt then state.leftHandWeight=1;state.lastLeftHandIK=TransformToLocalTransform(at,lt) end
    place(rt,"r");place(lt,"l")
    return true
end

local function sledge_vr_frame(locomotion, pt)
    local active,position=sledge_vr_active(locomotion)
    if not active then return end
    -- The Lua frame getter interpolates locomotion but native tool placement
    -- uses the current simulation pose. Align the local root to that same pose.
    if position then pt=Transform(position,pt.rot) end
    -- Animator motion normally updates in postUpdate (physics cadence).
    -- Refresh the local root at frame cadence too, without replaying the gait.
    if GetPlayerVehicle(locomotion.index)==0 and GetPlayerRig(locomotion.index)==0 then
        local state=locomotion.animState
        local sinking=-0.1*state.waterWeight*(1.0+state.crouchWeight)
        local at=TransformToParentTransform(pt,Transform(Vec(0,sinking,0),QuatEuler(0,180,0)))
        SetAnimatorTransform(locomotion.animator,at)
        sledge_vr_hands(locomotion,at)
    end
end

function client.draw()
	-- SLEDGE_TABLET_BEGIN: owned by SledgePort 7.17, no effect without matching DLL.
	local vrProtocol, vrEnabled = GetPlayerHealth(-717, 0)
	if vrProtocol == 717 and vrEnabled == 1 then
		local tabletRequest = GetPlayerHealth(-717, 7)
		if tabletRequest == 2 then gSledgeKeyboard = false end
		if tabletRequest == 1 then
			if spawnEnabled() then
				if spawnPlacement then spawnAbort() end
				spawnUi = true
				gFocusText = false
				gSetShortcut = false
				gNeedRefresh = true
				gSledgeTabletOwnsSpawn = true
			else
				GetPlayerHealth(-717, 6, 0)
			end
		end
		if gSledgeTabletOwnsSpawn then
			if GetPlayerHealth(-717, 5) ~= 2 then spawnUi = false end
			if not spawnUi then
				gSledgeTabletOwnsSpawn = false
				GetPlayerHealth(-717, 6, 0)
			end
		end
		GetPlayerHealth(-717, 8, spawnUi and 1 or 0, gSledgeKeyboard and 1 or 0)
	end
